description: This file defines a Clock class for managing and manipulating time within a browser context, including functions for fast forwarding, installing, pausing, resuming, and setting system or fixed times, as well as parsing time strings.

classes.name: Clock
classes.description: A class to control and manipulate clock behavior within a browser context for testing purposes.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Removes all init scripts related to the clock from the browser context.

methods.name: fastForward
methods.description: Fast forwards the clock by a specified number of ticks or time string.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a specific time or sets the clock to the current system time.

methods.name: pauseAt
methods.description: Pauses the clock at a specific tick or time.

methods.name: resumeNoReply
methods.description: Resumes the clock without waiting for a response.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes the clock, waiting for the operation to complete.

methods.name: setFixedTime
methods.description: Sets the clock to a fixed specific time.

methods.name: setSystemTime
methods.description: Sets the system time within the browser context.

methods.name: runFor
methods.description: Runs the clock forward for a specified number of ticks.

methods.name: _installIfNeeded
methods.description: Internal method to install clock scripts if not already installed.

methods.name: _evaluateInFrames
methods.description: Evaluates a script in all frames of the browser context.
